course_points.n: Start of ride; water on your left
Follow the bikepath straight during the roundabout to junction 23
At roundabout, take exit 3 onto Verlengde Schietweg
Turn slight left onto Burgemeester Ulco de Vriesweg
Turn left, cross street to junction 41
Continue straight, not onto the bikepath; cross the street
Cross street, then bear right onto the bikepath to junction 11
